changes.text: Git: incoming commits seen before pushing - background fetch every 3 min (git_autofetch, no password or login windows), incoming on top of the history and outgoing marked, Sync Changes (pull --rebase --autostash, then push) and Publish Branch under Commit, a refused push offers to pull and push; a branch without upstream is compared with origin/<branch>
New window: Ctrl+Shift+N, File > New Window and the palette start an empty window offset from this one; the terminal leaves the key to the window
Update notice: "updated to X" shows once - the state is saved without it on the first frame, new windows do not show it again
Terminal: keys go to the terminal (tmux's Ctrl+B, the shell's Ctrl+W) but the window's few, the wheel and clicks to programs that asked for the mouse, arrows in full-screen ones
Remote: folders on SSH hosts - one ssh.exe channel per host, files, quick open, TODO, search and git on the host, ssh terminal, password window (SSH_ASKPASS), connecting in the background
One folder, one window: a folder open in another window brings that window to the front, a second start opens empty; windows merge what they save in state.toml
Markdown preview: in a tab (Ctrl+Shift+V) and beside the editor (Ctrl+K V), check boxes toggle the text, links open files or the browser, images from the folder; Open Preview in the explorer's menu
Title bar: menu names stand apart - 10 pt at the sides, a gap between them, a rounded highlight on hover and while open; backlog: Markdown preview
Updates: check at start and once a day, Help > Check for Updates, status bar item, download with checks and exe swap, restart now or on next start
Explorer watcher test: give the watch a moment before changing files (wine sets up subfolder watches late); backlog: menu bar spacing, Help > Check for Updates
